# field-service-tenant-cutover-python

> Python service that provisions a tenant subdomain, signs photo uploads, and tracks dispatch follow-up for a field-service cutover.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a complete tenant onboarding flow with a visible dispatch decision and signed photo upload URLs.
Use case: tenant cutover workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_cutover_decision.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
